function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Statutes / Regulations | Practical Take‑aways | |-------|---------------------------|----------------------| | **Speed Limits** | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001–545.004 | • 55 mph on most interstates and freeways (unless posted otherwise).
• 45 mph on rural two‑lane roads.
• 35 mph on city streets unless posted. | | **Seat Belt & Child Restraint** | § 545.021 (seat belts), § 545.022 (child restraints) | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 years or 4 ft 9 in tall must use a child restraint system. | | **DUI / Alcohol** | § 545.041 (driving under influence), § 545.042 (driving with a blood alcohol concentration ≥ 0.08) | • Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Texting & Phone Use** | § 545.051 (hand‑held device use) | • Hand‑held devices are prohibited while driving.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | § 545.011 (right‑of‑way rules) | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights. | | **School Bus** | § 545.013 (school bus rules) | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Lane Discipline** | § 545.014 (lane discipline) | • Keep to the right lane unless passing. | | **Parking** | § 545.015 (parking regulations) | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk. | | **Vehicle Inspection & Registration** | § 545.001 (vehicle registration), § 545.002 (inspection) | • Annual inspection required for most vehicles.
• Registration renewal due annually. | | **Towing & Towage** | § 545.016 (towage) | • Towing companies must be licensed; towing without proper notice can be illegal. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | § 545.010 (traffic signals) | • Obey all traffic signals and signs; failure can result in citations. | --- ### How to Stay Informed | Resource | What It Offers | How to Access | |----------|----------------|---------------| | **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** | Official statutes, driver’s handbook, and updates on law changes | https://www.dps.texas.gov/ | | **Texas Transportation Code** | Full legal text of all traffic laws | https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/ | | **Texas Driver Handbook** | Practical guide for drivers, including new‑driver rules | https://www.dps.texas.gov/driverhandbook | | **Texas Courts** | Court decisions interpreting traffic laws | https://www.txcourts.gov/ | | **Legal Aid & Law Libraries** | Free legal research assistance | Local county law libraries or Texas Legal Services Center | --- ### Quick Tips for Compliance 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re there for safety. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or listen to music. 3. **Check your vehicle’s inspection status** before traveling long distances. 4. **Keep your driver's license and registration up to date** to avoid penalties. 5. **If you’re unsure about a specific law**, consult the Texas Driver Handbook or contact the DPS. --- #### Need More Detail? If you have a specific scenario (e.g., “What are the penalties for a first‑time DUI?” or “How does Texas handle traffic violations for commercial trucks?”), let me know and I can dive deeper into the relevant statutes or even pull up recent court cases using the lawsuit_search tool.
